about_short_description.short_description: ADNOC is a oil company that provides energy production and petroleum products for the Oil and Gas industry.

product.name: Crude Oil
product.description: Production and supply of crude oil, including Murban crude, from ADNOC’s onshore and offshore fields for domestic and international customers.

product.name: Natural Gas
product.description: Natural gas production, processing and marketing for residential, commercial, industrial and international customers.

product.name: Refined Petroleum Products
product.description: Refined fuels and petroleum products manufactured for domestic use and export markets, including transport and industrial applications.

product.name: Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG)
product.description: Liquefied natural gas produced for export and international supply under long-term commercial agreements.

product.name: Gas Processing Products
product.description: Processed gas and natural-gas liquids, including ethane, NGLs, condensate and sulfur, produced from ADNOC’s gas operations.

product.name: Petrochemical and Polyolefin Solutions
product.description: Polyolefin and other petrochemical materials used in infrastructure, energy, mobility, agriculture, healthcare and advanced packaging.
